description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for the generic Stack<T> type in Orleans serialization framework, including a serializer class (StackCodec<T>) and a copier class (StackCopier<T>) with methods for writing, reading, and deep copying stacks.

classes.name: StackCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Stack<T> providing methods to write and read stack data for serialization.

classes.name: StackCopier<T>
classes.description: Copier for Stack<T> providing deep copy functionality.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Stack<T> into a writer stream, handling references and writing stack elements.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from a reader stream into a Stack<T> instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Stack<T> instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from one Stack<T> to another, performing deep copies of elements.
